text: Converts any URL into clean, LLM-ready text via a simple GET request
quote: It converts any URL to an **LLM-friendly** input with `https://r.jina.ai/https://your.url`.

text: Search the web by query and get full page content from the top results in one call
quote: It searches the web for a given query with `https://s.jina.ai/your+query`. This allows your LLMs to access the latest world knowledge from the web.

text: Accepts PDF and MS Office (Word/Excel/PowerPoint) files posted directly, no hosting required
quote: PDFs and MS Office documents (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) can now be POSTed directly via the `file` body field — no need to host them first.

text: Auto-captions images missing alt text using a vision-language model for text-only LLM consumption
quote: All images on a page that lack an `alt` tag can be auto-captioned by a VLM (vision-language model) and formatted as `![Image [idx]: [VLM_caption]](img_URL)`

text: Choose the output format returned (e.g. markdown with YAML frontmatter) via a header
quote: `x-respond-with` — select the output format. ... `frontmatter` returns **Markdown with a YAML frontmatter block**

text: Apply a 'research' preset bundle tuned for AI research agents needing structured, citable output
quote: `x-preset` — apply a pre-packaged option bundle for common scenarios. ... `research` — for AI research agents needing structured, citable output.

text: Control when the response is returned, trading off latency against completeness
quote: `x-respond-timing` — explicit control over *when* Reader is willing to return. Trade off latency against completeness

text: Prebuilt container image bundles headless Chrome, LibreOffice, and CJK fonts for easy self-hosted deployment
quote: A prebuilt image of the open-source branch is published to GitHub Container Registry. It bundles headless Chrome, LibreOffice, and CJK fonts, so you can run Reader without building it yourself.

text: Hosted proxy pool rotates residential/datacenter IPs to avoid blocks
quote: Route through the SaaS proxy with `-H 'x-proxy: auto'` (key required). Reader's hosted proxy pool rotates residential / datacenter IPs and handles common anti-bot challenges automatically.

text: Hosted proxy automatically handles common anti-bot challenges
quote: Route through the SaaS proxy with `-H 'x-proxy: auto'` (key required). Reader's hosted proxy pool rotates residential / datacenter IPs and handles common anti-bot challenges automatically.

text: Forwards user-supplied session cookies when fetching a URL for authenticated access
quote: Pass your session cookies with the `X-Set-Cookie` header and the Reader forwards them when fetching the URL

text: Optionally returns the markdown response chunked semantically instead of one large blob
quote: `x-markdown-chunking` — opt-in semantic chunking of the markdown response. Returns a JSON array (or ``-delimited text) of chunks instead of one blob

text: Extract specific fields from a page by supplying a JSON schema definition
quote: Use the `x-json-schema` header with a JSON schema definition, or use `x-instruction` header with natural language instructions. Both features work with ReaderLM-v2 to extract specific fields

text: Extract specific fields from a page using natural language instructions instead of selectors
quote: Use the `x-json-schema` header with a JSON schema definition, or use `x-instruction` header with natural language instructions. Both features work with ReaderLM-v2 to extract specific fields

text: Search results can be restricted to specific sites via a site query parameter
quote: curl 'https://s.jina.ai/When%20was%20Jina%20AI%20founded%3F?site=jina.ai&site=github.com'

text: Fetches content from the top 5 search result URLs automatically alongside search
quote: `http://s.jina.ai` automatically fetches the content from the top 5 search result URLs for you (reusing the tech stack behind `http://r.jina.ai`).

text: Parses PDFs at any URL using PDF.js
quote: **PDFs** — any URL, parsed with PDF.js.

text: Converts MS Office documents via LibreOffice then processes as HTML/PDF
quote: **MS Office documents** — Word, Excel, PowerPoint, converted via LibreOffice and then processed as HTML/PDF.

text: Force a specific fetching engine: headless browser, lightweight curl, or automatic combination
quote: `x-engine` — enforces a fetching engine: `browser` (headless Chrome), `curl` (lightweight, no JS), or `auto` (the default — Combined use of both browser and curl).

text: Trim the returned response so it never exceeds a specified token count
quote: `x-max-tokens` — integer (≥500). Trim the response so it never exceeds this many tokens.

text: Mitigate preload/placeholder content by waiting for network idle or for a specific element to appear
quote: Reader may capture the preload content instead. Two ways to mitigate: ... wait for network idle or until timeout ... wait for a specific element

text: Point Reader at an S3-compatible bucket to cache fetched pages and reuse them across requests
quote: Point Reader at an S3-compatible bucket to cache fetched pages and reuse them across requests

text: Set browser locale via a header so region/locale-specific page markup can be steered
quote: Content negotiation is available through the `X-Locale` header, which sets the browser locale used when rendering, so sites that serve different markup per locale can be steered to the version you want.

text: Scraping is streamlined and reliable compared to handling complex/dynamic pages yourself
quote: Scraping can be complicated and unreliable, particularly with complex or dynamic pages. The Reader API provides a streamlined, reliable output of clean, LLM-ready text.
